mission: Test existing eight-neuron recurrent controller acquisition of useful COM coordination through bounded evolutionary optimization, separately from lifetime plasticity.
production_changes: None planned to physics, body, energetic coefficients, anatomy, ordinary nursery default or head aesthetics. Default-valued feedback ablation option may be added with exact old encoding/replay compatibility. No scripted waveform in the selected neural policy.
research: No external scientific literature consulted/planned. This is a source-derived authored experiment. Any later scientific search must be announced first and recorded.
nursery: One existing founder, reference12 spine+2 jaw joints,26 rotational axes+4 other motor outputs.16-cubed periodic empty world, no food/nutrients/reservoir/inflow, populationcap1, law2/waveoff/drag8 normally.4096 initial energy, existing maintenance1 and neural/motor fees; reset episodes are provisioned assays, not survival. No target or global coordinates in107-scalar neural ABI.

capability_budget.conditions: three initial orientations including unfamiliar mild pose; drag8/32; original, random, rest, M5singlepulse and M5periodic mechanical controls
capability_budget.gate: At least one paid repeated diagnostic control shows net>=0.5 site, last two quarter projections>=0.10 site each, and last-half directional travel advantage>=0.05 site over matched zero-command continuation. No jets. If absent, do not launch optimization until blocker investigated or gate explicitly revised with evidence.

babbling_budget.families: random individual holds, reversals, simultaneous random contractions, seeded sequential permutation, independent random phase/amplitude/duration. No chosen successful coordination copied into neural weights.
babbling_budget.plasticity: Existing plasticity enabled during external babbling; no locomotion-specific feedback or immediate competence claim. Externally submitted commands and resulting neural changes retained.

evolution_budget.selection: ranked elites4 plus4 fresh random immigrants per generation; other offspring mutate selected parent NN parameters. Preserve genome IDs/parents/mutations/full candidates and diversity statistics.
evolution_budget.mutated_parameters: bounded recurrent/sensory/joint-output weights, biases, joint motor biases and tau. Body genes, gains, strengths, plastic rates, anatomy and last4 motor-output parameters remain fixed.
evolution_budget.gate: Capability and babble precede optimization. This bounded pilot is not authority for a larger undisclosed campaign.

components: actual advantage over matched zero-command last-half coast
paid actuator energy and pending fractional debt
fitness.scalar: net +4*positive_min_last2_quarter_projection +2*positive_active_gain +0.25*net/(1+effective_actuator_energy) -0.001*effective_actuator_energy -0.002*rotation_radians. Mean across three training conditions. All components retained separately.
fitness.near_zero: net<0.05: energy/distance reported null and efficiency credit0. Mouth displacement earns no score; zero jets required.

held_out.use: Do not evaluate before final genome locked. New orientations and bounded initial joint poses; drag8 and32. No final food scenarios used in optimization.

gates.G3: record paired held-out selected-minus-original net distances, mean/median/range and bootstrap95% interval; PASS only meaningful positive >=0.25-site median and at least6/8wins, with selection score improvement
gates.G4: net>=0.5, last2 quarter projections>=0.10 each, active_gain>=0.05, active commands in final half, no jets
gates.G6: G4 in at least6/8held-out conditions; otherwise partial/fail as measured

held_out.clarification: Primary genetic comparison uses selected_frozen and original_frozen (plasticityoff). Also test selected_live/original_live with existing physiological plasticity enabled. Additional recurrenceoff and feedbackoff selected probes separate source of coordination. All conditions fixed before optimizer starts; held-out seeds remain unopened until final selection.

lifetime.assessment: Reset only assay body/energy to matched physical starts and reset fast neural activation/muscle state for parameter-retention readout. Preserve learned plastic weights for frozen post probes, disable further updates. Also compare carry-state probes and fresh inherited/offspring-without-mutation parameter probes. Explicitly report resets, distinguish evolved genes, retained lifetime weights, fast-state carryover and inheritance.
lifetime.learning_law: Existing feedback is energy-delta modulation, not a locomotion-reward channel. No new motor learning law silently introduced. Feedback-off is an explicit ablation, not new positive feedback.
lifetime.G7: Requires pre/post competence improvement, persistence with feedback removed, generalization and improvement relative to plasticityoff/feedbackoff controls. Synaptic changes alone insufficient.

curriculum: A/B measured first. C changing-direction cue and D integrated recovery/braking only after sustained competence. E spatial exploration and F normal-budget food transfer only after prerequisites. Blocked stages labelled NOT RUN, not failures or successes. If A/B succeed, register any cue and later campaign before running; no target vectors secretly injected.
visual: Selectable selected/original/compare demo in existing viewer, using native recurrent ticks. Default nursery unchanged. Record screenshots/short capture and inspect actual pixels before claiming visual witness. A selected checkpoint with failed gates must be labelled candidate, not competent learner.
integrity: Raw traces, checkpoints, every failed episode and selected lineage in external working cache, then verified versioned Mermogon archive with restore test. Git keeps protocol, code, small selected/original genotype metadata, metrics/analysis, hash/restore index and report. Per-tick full dynamic neural state/motor/physical response, initial/final hashes and deterministic replay. No commits/pushes without explicit user instruction.
direction_campaign_after_AB: After locked movement candidate passed sustained gate8/8 held-out starts, register a second bounded pilot: population12,generations6,training episodes301/302/303 x128ticks,seed60620261123,max300seconds. Warm-start selected recurrent genome; mutate NN genes only, no body/coefficient changes. Directions delivered as an explicitly authored authoritative nutrient-gradient cue with uptake0, no food objective. Initial direction then opposite after64ticks, material-conserving environmental field rearrangement; no body position/velocity edit. Ordinary existing LocalLobesV1 signals only. Evaluator sees world-axis direction outside NN. Score=2*signedCOMprogress +2*min(phaseprogress) -0.001*effectiveactuatorenergy -0.002*rotation; any secretion jets receive score -1000 and no joint-locomotion credit. Fresh direction-test seeds701..708 opened only after directional selection; success both phases>=0.1site and no jets in>=6/8. If fails, integrated stopping/exploration/ecological transfer NOT RUN.
cue_interface_failure_and_v2: The v1 direction campaign ran before interface validation. Its field weights64+8*coordinate (total507904) saturated all6LocalLobesV1 channels at1024. Preserve direction-v1 and direction-heldout-v1 as INVALID CUE, not evidence of failed steering acquisition. Correct only explicit training cue concentration to4+coordinate (total47104), keeping the existing sensor/physics/energy laws unchanged. Run sensor/material/no-impulse regression FIRST; then rerun same bounded direction optimizer budget/seed as direction-v2, and fresh held-out701..708 as direction-heldout-v2. No v1 trials erased; raw initial/changed field arrays permit exact historical replay despite changed cue-construction helper.

post_selection_falsification.purpose: Mechanistic probes only; no candidate retuning or new selection. Registered after primary and steering results.
